name: KYC Verification Workflow
description: Complete KYC verification process with document upload and liveness check

steps.title: Welcome
steps.description: Welcome to the KYC process. I will guide you step by step.
steps.instructions: Welcome the user and explain the KYC process

steps.title: Enter Room ID
steps.description: Please enter the Room ID to join the KYC session.
steps.instructions: Enter the Room ID provided to you to join the existing KYC session.

steps.title: Take Selfie
steps.description: Please capture a selfie for liveness verification.
steps.instructions: Look directly at the camera and smile naturally. Ensure good lighting and clear visibility of your face.

questions.question: What is your date of birth?

steps.title: ID Document Upload
steps.description: Please upload your ID document (PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, or Passport).
steps.instructions: Upload a clear photo of your ID document. Ensure all text is readable and the document is not damaged.

steps.title: Verification Complete
steps.description: Your KYC verification has been completed successfully.
steps.instructions: Thank the user and confirm completion
